correctness.rationale: From any TCP factorization of \((J_d,J_d,Z)\), \(\operatorname{rank}(B)=1\) forces every vector \(v_k\odot w_k\) to be a scalar multiple of the all-ones vector. Therefore \(v_k\odot\overline{w_k}\) has constant coordinate modulus \(|c_k|\), and the unit diagonal of \(Z\) normalizes the squared moduli into convex weights, proving \(Z\) toroidal. The converse is the published toroidal TCP-core construction. Scaling and the source identities \(r_1=1\), \(s_1=4\), and \(M_1=J_4\) give the DOC endpoint result. The explicit \(Z_*\) is \(U^*U\), has rank \(2\), and the four equations \(u_j^*Xu_j=0\) force \(X=0\), proving extremality and hence non-toroidality. The packaged exact checker returned `VERIFY_OK`.
